title: Production policy binding handoff for independently qualified head-budget normalization

handoff.suggested_title: Explicit Richards Head-Budget Certificate Production Policy Binding

fixed_semantics.H_budget_requirement: explicit finite positive head-domain numerical/application accuracy budget in cm with independent provenance
fixed_semantics.F_KT09_acceptance_surface: certificate available, finite, nonnegative and C_h<=1

required_F_KT11_scope: Bind an explicitly supplied valid H_budget to the F-SI25/F-KT10 production indicator path and emit dimensionless C_h through the already-qualified F-KT09 trial_outcome certificate fields.
Keep H_budget in numerical/application policy configuration, not physical parameters or persistent column state.
Do not hard-code, infer, calibrate or default H_budget.
Preserve F-KT09 exact checkpoint/retry/rollback/commit semantics and the independent hard-mass gate.
Preserve zero additional full nonlinear trajectories and no additional normalization solve beyond the already-qualified one-defect-TRIDAG indicator path.
Make invalid/missing H_budget or unavailable B_inf produce certificate unavailable/fail closed.
Expose diagnostics sufficient to distinguish raw B_inf, configured H_budget, dimensionless C_h and unavailable reason without reinterpreting B_inf as nonlinear true error.

continuation_blocker.rule: F-KT11 must fail closed when the indicator history/provenance is unavailable; it must not invent a bootstrap derivative or treat retry as a bootstrap mechanism.

must_not_admit: a numerical H_budget value or universal tolerance
implicit restart or discontinuity provenance repair
downstream_after_owner_F_KT11: Independent F-VQ qualification of the actual production policy binding is required before release.
Continuation/bootstrap provenance must be separately qualified if production entry from no-history or discontinuity is required.
Resume the existing F-GC02 only when both production policy and required continuation dependencies are independently closed.
